# TextField theming

The values listed below are exposed as `--rozie-text-field-*` custom properties, each with a built-in fallback, so `TextField` works with **zero configuration** and re-skins by remapping tokens. The structural rules compile per-leaf and are **not** consumer-overridable.

```css
:root {
  --rozie-text-field-width: 100%;
  --rozie-text-field-label-size: 0.875rem;
  --rozie-text-field-bg: #fff;
  --rozie-text-field-adornment-gap: 0.5rem;
}
```

## Tokens

### field column

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--rozie-text-field-width` | `100%` |
| `--rozie-text-field-gap` | `0.375rem` |
| `--rozie-text-field-font` | `inherit` |
| `--rozie-text-field-color` | `inherit` |

### label

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--rozie-text-field-label-size` | `0.875rem` |
| `--rozie-text-field-label-weight` | `500` |
| `--rozie-text-field-label-color` | `inherit` |

### control box

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--rozie-text-field-bg` | `#fff` |
| `--rozie-text-field-border-width` | `1px` |
| `--rozie-text-field-border-color` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)` |
| `--rozie-text-field-radius` | `0.5rem` |
| `--rozie-text-field-padding-x` | `0.75rem` |
| `--rozie-text-field-padding-y` | `0.5rem` |
| `--rozie-text-field-line-height` | `1.5` |
| `--rozie-text-field-placeholder-color` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)` |
| `--rozie-text-field-resize` | `vertical` |

## Design-system bridges

Each package ships token presets that map TextField's tokens onto a known design system's published CSS variables — import `base.css` first, then a bridge:

```ts
import '@rozie-ui/text-field-react/themes/base.css';
import '@rozie-ui/text-field-react/themes/bootstrap.css';
import '@rozie-ui/text-field-react/themes/material.css';
import '@rozie-ui/text-field-react/themes/shadcn.css';
```
